D: Doctor Strange protects a teenager who can travel between universes from a powerful witch.
P: Serve the snacks when Strange and America find the pizza ball stall.
S: Pizza dough wrapped around mozzarella and pepperoni, baked in a tin
Pizza dough wrapped around cubes of mozzarella and pepperoni, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes, brushed with garlic butter and served with tomato sauce.
Christine's wedding salmon and fig canapés

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and fig and goat's cheese bites. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 120g crème fraîche with lemon zest and top each blini with a spoon of it, a fold of smoked salmon and a dill sprig. Quarter 4 fresh figs. Sit each quarter on a small crostini with a little soft goat's cheese from 120g, drizzle with honey and add cracked pepper. Arrange both on a platter.
Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with a charred tomato chilli sauce
Chicken and spring onion dumplings with ginger, steamed 10 minutes, with a spicy tomato achar.
M: Braised pork belly, miso broth, ramen noodles and soft boiled eggs
Ramen noodles in a pork and miso broth with braised pork belly, soft-boiled eggs, corn and nori, every bowl topped a little differently.
Wanda's dream of a family life

Beef meatballs browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, served over spaghetti with garlic bread and parmesan, family style. Mix 600g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and salt and roll into 20 meatballs. Brown in olive oil and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion in the same pan, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and basil and simmer 15 minutes. Add the meatballs and simmer 25 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked spaghetti and serve with parmesan and garlic bread.
W: Fried rice flour rings with cardamom, crisp outside and soft inside

Crisp Nepali sweet rice flour rings scented with cardamom and butter, fried golden in big loops and served warm from the pan. Mix 300g rice flour, 100g sugar, 50g melted butter, 1 tsp ground cardamom and 250ml milk into a thick batter and rest 1 hour. Pour rings into oil at 175C and fry until golden on both sides.
K: Black tea simmered with milk, cardamom, cinnamon, ginger and cloves
Black tea simmered with milk, cardamom, cinnamon, ginger and cloves, sweetened and strained.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in the oven

steps.text: Cube the mozzarella and heat the oven to 200C.
Cut the dough into small pieces and wrap each around a cube of cheese and a slice of pepperoni.
Roll into balls and pack into a greased tin.
Bake until golden.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic and brush over the balls. Warm the sauce for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in the oven

steps.text: Cube the mozzarella, cut the capsicum into small pieces and heat the oven to 200C.
Cut the dough into small pieces and wrap each around a cube of cheese, a piece of capsicum and a pinch of smoked paprika.
Roll into balls and pack into a greased tin.
Bake until golden.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic and brush over the balls. Warm the sauce for dipping.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and pleat the momos up to 1 day ahead on a floured tray, covered in the fridge; make the achar up to 3 days ahead and steam to serve

Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam the momos.
Char the tomatoes in a dry pan, then blitz with chilli flakes, salt and garlic for the achar.

veg.make_ahead: Make the filling and fill the momos up to 1 day ahead on a floured tray, covered in the fridge; make the achar up to 3 days ahead and steam to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and cabbage in the oil until soft and dry, then cool.
Mix with the soy sauce, sliced spring onion and ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam the momos.
Char the tomatoes in a dry pan, then blitz with chilli flakes, salt and garlic for the achar.

dishes.make_ahead: Braise the pork and soft-boil the eggs up to 2 days ahead, chilled; heat the stock and cook the noodles on the night

steps.text: Braise the pork belly in soy and water until tender, then slice.
Simmer the pork.
Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Heat the stock and whisk in the miso.
Cook the noodles and build each bowl differently with pork, eggs, corn and nori.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the tofu and simmer the shiitake up to 1 day ahead, chilled; soft-boil the eggs, heat the stock and cook the noodles on the night

steps.text: Fry the tofu in the oil until golden on both sides.
Add the shiitake, soy sauce, sugar and water and simmer, turning, until sticky.
Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Heat the stock and whisk in the miso.
Cook the noodles and build each bowl differently with tofu, shiitake, eggs, corn and nori.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the batter up to 1 day ahead and rest it covered in the fridge; fry on the day, best eaten warm

steps.text: Mix the rice flour, sugar, butter, cardamom and milk into a thick batter.
Rest the batter.
Pour rings of batter into oil at 175C and fry until golden on both sides.

dishes.make_ahead: Best made fresh and served hot; crush the cardamom and slice the ginger up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Crush the cardamom pods.
Simmer the water with the cardamom, cinnamon stick, cloves and ginger.
Add the tea bags and milk, bring just to the boil and sweeten with the caster sugar.
Strain into cups.

s.note: Pizza dough wrapped around mozzarella and pepperoni, baked in a tin
s.how: Cut pizza dough into small pieces and wrap each around a cube of mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Roll into balls and pack into a greased tin. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, brush with garlic butter and serve with warm pizza sauce.

s.note: Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with a charred tomato chilli sauce
s.how: Mix 400g chicken mince with sliced spring onion and grated ginger. Fill dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam for 10 minutes. Char 3 tomatoes in a dry pan and blitz with chilli flakes, salt and a little garlic for a spicy achar to dip.

m.note: Braised pork belly, miso broth, ramen noodles and soft boiled eggs
m.how: Braise 600g pork belly in soy and water for 2 hours, then slice. Whisk white miso into hot stock for the broth. Cook ramen noodles and soft-boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes. Build each bowl a little differently with pork, halved eggs, corn and nori.

w.note: Fried rice flour rings with cardamom, crisp outside and soft inside
w.how: Mix 300g rice flour, 100g sugar, 50g melted butter, 1 tsp ground cardamom and 250ml milk into a thick batter and rest 1 hour. Pour rings into oil at 175C and fry until golden on both sides.

d.note: Black tea simmered with milk, cardamom, cinnamon, ginger and cloves
d.how: Simmer 500ml water with 4 crushed cardamom pods, 1 cinnamon stick, 4 slices ginger and 4 cloves for 5 minutes. Add 4 black tea bags and 500ml milk, bring just to the boil, sweeten with 3 tbsp sugar and strain into cups.
